notes.title: Disposable Corps Playtest Begins
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Commanders![/p][p]We’re excited to announce that we’ll be running private playtests for Disposable Corps on a regular basis moving forward. Unlike public demos, these playtests will be smaller, invite-only sessions that give you a first look at new systems while helping us gather the feedback we need to keep improving the game.[/p][p]Our first playtest begins now, and you can sign up today:[/p][list][*][p]Best option: sign up on our website for the earliest access waves → [url="https://dc.lightup.games/"]https://dc.lightup.games/[/url][/p][/*][*][p]You can also request access on the store page, though slots there will open later than the website.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quick controls to get you started[/b]
Disposable Corps is a tactical shooter. These basics will help you jump in fast:[/p][list][*][p][b]B[/b] – Buy weapons and items[/p][/*][*][p][b]I[/b] – Build fortifications[/p][/*][*][p][b]M[/b] – Open map and recruit AI soldiers at spawn icons[/p][/*][*][p][b]T[/b] – Open the command menu to issue orders to your AI squad[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569017/5753016a4bc98553703712ddfc11ae16fe45ee9a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Playtest feedback + rewards[/b]
When you exit the game you’ll see a feedback button. Please share your thoughts and include a screenshot of your Steam playtime.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569017/b758417c5a656c2625ff4fe5bc753abc07e64404.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]All participants who submit feedback will receive the [b]Playtester DEVGRU Badge[/b] in version 1.0[/p][/*][*][p]The player with the longest verified playtime will also earn a [b]special[/b] [b]DEVGRU[/b] [b]Ribbon[/b] cosmetic in version 1.0[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Contest details[/b][/p][list][*][p]Do not delete the game from your Steam library after playtesting or your playtime cannot be verified[/p][/*][*][p]Submissions close on [b]October 8[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Winner announced on [b]October 30[/b] via Steam announcement[/p][/*][*][p]The winner will be chosen based on verified playtime.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Join the community[/b]
[b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN"]https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN[/url][/p][p][b]QQ:[/b] 577020498[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning. We’ll be hosting more playtests with new features in the future, and your feedback will directly shape the direction of Disposable Corps.[/p][p][/p][p][b]— Armoured Dudes[/b][/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update Now Live for TPS Fest
notes.content:
[p][b]Greetings, Commanders![/b][/p][p]We are excited to share that [b]Disposable Corps is part of TPS Fest[/b] and the biggest demo update yet is now live. The highlight of this update is a brand-new [b]buildable vehicle factory[/b] that lets you bring additional chaos to the battlefield.[/p][p]Alongside the vehicle factory, the demo has been improved with better combat flow and balancing. This update delivers the clearest look so far at Disposable Corps’ unique mix of squad tactics and high-intensity firefights.[/p][p]We’ve also put together a new gameplay trailer that gives the best look yet at Disposable Corps in action.[/p][previewyoutube="Nw5H4gRXjbQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]👉 [b]Play the updated demo now and add Disposable Corps to your wishlist:[/b]
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579070/Disposable_Corps/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][p]🎯 [b]Want to go even deeper?[/b][/p][p]We’ll be running future [b]closed playtests[/b] with new features that go beyond the demo. If you want to take part, sign up here: [url="https://dc.lightup.games/"]https://dc.lightup.games/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]💬 [b]Join the community:[/b][/p][p][b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN"]https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN[/url][/p][p][b]QQ: [/b]577020498[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for checking out Disposable Corps during TPS Fest. We cannot wait to hear what you think of the new demo and the vehicle factory.[/p][p][b]— Armoured Dudes[/b][/p]

notes.title: [DEMO] Update – July Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569017/7b7ea11e70324935499fc41e1fd96a7ef19ef6cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Commander,[/p][p]
We’ve been hard at work squashing bugs, optimizing systems, and making sure your battles are smoother and more stable. Here’s what’s new in this update:

[/p][previewyoutube="mbK5C0fL7Pw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]🔧 Major Fixes & Optimizations[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]LOD Overhaul:[/b] Optimized character rendering by swapping to low-cost hard-surface meshes at long distances. Less lag, more action![/p][/*][*][p][b]Network Sync Boost:[/b] New prediction and sync tech slashed NPC data load by up to [b]80%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Physics Rework:[/b] Improved character physics to prevent crazy knockbacks and glitchy interactions from latency.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop Bug Fixed:[/b] You can now access the shop as intended. Time to gear up![/p][/*][*][p][b]Clone Wars Ending (Mostly):[/b] Fixed the player clone bug — though a few ghosts still haunt the system occasionally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn Issues Resolved:[/b] Characters now reliably appear where they should.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No More NPC Mix-ups:[/b] Your character won’t accidentally become an NPC anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Artillery Bug Fix:[/b] If you survive on a destroyed artillery seat, you’ll now keep your building rights.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Coordinate Sync Patch:[/b] Forced coordinate validation added to keep positions consistent across all clients.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]⚠️ Known Issues (Still Being Monitored):[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Kill logs are a bit off — some AI kills are being counted as player kills.[/p][/*][*][p]Rare headless clones may still appear (we’re tracking it!).[/p][/*][*][p]A few NPCs believe they can fly — we’re working on grounding them.[/p][/*][*][p]Heavy artillery gunners might be invisible, but don’t worry — players can still operate them.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you, Commander, for leading the charge and helping us shape Disposable Corps through your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💬 Stay Connected[/b][/h3][p]We’d love to hear more from you, whether it’s bug reports, feedback, or just a chat with fellow Commanders:[/p][p]🔗 Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN"]https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN[/url][/p][p]🔗 QQ: 577020498[/p][p][/p][p]More updates are on the horizon — stay alert and ready.[/p][p][b]Until then, carry on.[/b]
[/p][p][b]— AD Dev Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 📢 [DEMO] Big Fixes, New Features & More to Come
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569017/7b7ea11e70324935499fc41e1fd96a7ef19ef6cb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hey everyone, [/p][p]First off, from the whole Disposable Corps dev team – thank you for your support, feedback, bug reports, and patience. We’ve been working non-stop to improve the game, and it means a lot to see the community growing and helping us shape it into something better every day.  [/p][p][/p][p]We know it's been a bumpy ride at times, but we’re committed to listening, fixing, and evolving. Your voices truly matter, and we read every single comment, post, and report you share with us. Sometimes we may not respond right away ([i]because we’re deep in code[/i]), but rest assured – we’re always watching, always fixing.  [/p][p][/p][p]Here's a quick look at what’s already been done and what’s new in this latest update:  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]✅ Previous Fixes (Unannounced Until Now)[/b] [/h3][p]🧱 Faster Sandbag Construction [/p][p]🌐 Language Settings Now Save Correctly [/p][p]💥 Tank Crew No Longer Fall Into the Void After Explosion [/p][p]🎯 AI Target Vector Bug Resolved (was causing server issues) [/p][p]❌ Exit Button Now Works on Failed Connections – press ESC to restart  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚀 What's New update[/b] [/h3][p]🛠 Improved Equipment Syncing – Working to fix gear not showing up after purchase [/p][p]🚜 A7V Tank Bug Fixed – No more uncontrollable spinning due to track issues [/p][p]🌍 Server Region Filter Added – Find servers closer to you (remember to turn off VPNs for best results) [/p][p]🚫 Local Blacklist/Whitelist System – More control over your matches [/p][p]🎵 Temporary Opening BGM: “Garlic Bird” – Enjoy the vibes! [/p][p]💬 Typing Chat System Added – Communicate more easily on the field [/p][p]🧪 Developer Mode Enabled – Error logs now visible if something goes wrong  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧭 Coming Up Next...[/b] [/h3][p]We’re not stopping here. More content, more fixes, and more polish are on the way. Stay with us – the battlefield is only getting better.  [/p][p][/p][h3][b]💬 Stay Connected[/b] [/h3][p]We’d love to hear more from you, whether it’s bug reports, feedback, or just a chat with fellow Commanders: [/p][p]🔗 Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN"]https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN[/url] [/p][p]🔗 QQ: 577020498[/p]

notes.title: Disposable Corps Demo Now Available
notes.content:
The Disposable Corps demo is now live and ready to play. This is our first public release, and we're looking forward to hearing what you think.

This build gives you a hands-on look at our take on fast-paced, team-based trench warfare. You can build defenses, push the frontline, and test out different loadouts as you fight for ground.

We're still actively developing the game, so your feedback during the demo period is important to us. If you run into any issues, have suggestions, or just want to share your thoughts, the best place to do that is in our Discord server.

You can join here: [url=https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN]https://discord.gg/vtDYcDt8yN[/url]

[b]In case you missed it[/b]

We recently released our reveal trailer. If you haven't seen it yet, it's a good look at the tone and pacing of the game. You can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=k_Hc9ou8Z4s;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks for checking out the demo. We hope you have fun, and we’re looking forward to hearing what you think.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617330/Disposable_Corps_Demo/

notes.title: Disposable Corps Officially Revealed – Demo Launches May 16
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re excited to officially reveal Disposable Corps, a real-time tactical defense game where chaos is part of the plan and your squad is… well, highly expendable.

Check out the new reveal trailer to get a first look at the gameplay and art style.

[previewyoutube=k_Hc9ou8Z4s;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]The first public demo goes live on Steam this Friday, May 16.[/b]

You’ll be able to jump into multiplayer matches and lead your squad through unpredictable, fast-paced battles. It’s all about quick decisions, last-second saves, and a whole lot of mayhem.

Add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned—we’ll have more to share once the demo is live.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579070/Disposable_Corps/
